source_map.field: all cpu fields (name, cores, socket, launch, architecture, isa, memory.*, igpu)
source_map.note: One page per model, section General Specifications. Reads with page.py. Three URL families: (a) current desktop pages https://www.amd.com/en/products/processors/desktops/ryzen/<N>000-series/amd-ryzen-<tier>-<model>.html exist for 5000, 7000, 8000, 9000 (404 for 1000 to 3000); (b) the same spec table is on https://www.amd.com/en/support/downloads/drivers.html/processors/ryzen/ryzen-<N>000-series/amd-ryzen-<tier>-<model>.html (1000 to 3000) and .../processors/ryzen-threadripper/ryzen-threadripper-<N>000-series/amd-ryzen-threadripper-<model>.html, and .../processors/ryzen-threadripper-pro/(amd-)ryzen-threadripper-pro-<N>000-wx-series/amd-ryzen-threadripper-pro-<model>.html; (c) laptop pages https://www.amd.com/en/products/processors/laptop/ryzen/<N>000-series/amd-ryzen-<tier>-<model>.html and .../ai-300-series/amd-ryzen-ai-9-hx-370.html.

Row 'Max Memory Speed' per DIMM configuration on 5-digit-era pages (3000 desktop with 2 channels, 7000, 8000, 9000, TR 3000 3990X). Older pages (1000, 2000, 3000 low end, 5000, TR 1000/2000/3960X, TR 7000/9000, PRO 7000/9000) give one line 'System Memory Specification Up to N MT/s' instead.
Row 'Memory Channels'. Absent on the Ryzen 5000 pages and on the 3000 pages other than 3950X.
Row 'Max. Memory'. Absent on 1000, 2000, 5000, TR 1000/2000, TR 3960X, TR 7000/9000 and PRO pages; the 9950X product page (256 GB) and shop page (192 GB) disagree.
AMD states no memory bandwidth on any page opened; derived per schema rule 4. The Threadripper PRO white paper and tech briefs are PDFs (not readable here).
Row 'Supported Extensions' (3000 and later pages, not 1000, 2000, 5000). It lists AVX512 as one item; AVX-512 sub-features (VNNI, BF16) are on no page opened.
Row 'Graphics Model'; 'Discrete Graphics Card Required' means none.
Pages carry 'Form Factor' (and 'Market Segment' on newer pages); mapped to the schema values with a note.
